summary: T18 CalDAV production hardening verified: malformed/oversized/throttled requests fail before writes, logs carry no credentials or bodies, production transport fails closed, and metrics classify failures. All 96 caldav tests plus the full backend suite pass.
important_context: DAV auth rate limiter (10 attempts/60s per client IP) is checked in authenticate_dav_request before any handler logic, so throttled reads and writes both fail pre-write.
Access log middleware (backend/src/http.rs:2545) logs only method/path/status/bytes/latency/request_id; it never logs the Authorization header or request body.
SecretToken Debug impl (backend/src/security.rs:250) redacts to SecretToken([REDACTED]); caldav resource names are UUIDv4 so logged paths are safe.
validate_caldav_public_origin (backend/src/config.rs:259) rejects non-HTTPS CALDAV_PUBLIC_ORIGIN in production and requires the origin to be present.
